'''Eddey Be'ray''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked with [[Reen Irana]]. He was regarded as an excellent [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. He was known to wear a duster.
